todos.title: Phase 0 observability: implementation
todos.description: Implement privacy-safe in-process observability for passive-event storms, background-task scans, and discovery outcomes. Reuse existing metrics patterns; expose counters through an existing management surface or bounded periodic log. No prompt/response/full-path logging.
todos.notes: Starting on latest inspected HEAD 827f9d2 after origin fetch; branch plan/approval-layer is ahead of origin/main and contains the reviewed plan.

verification.summary: Implemented aggregate-only runtime diagnostics: passive event counters, background-task request/active counters, codex-remote item-request/scan counters, discovery outcome/duration counters, goroutine count, and process CPU seconds. Exposed via authenticated GET /internal/diagnostics/runtime on latest inspected HEAD 827f9d2.

todos.title: Phase 2 background-task starvation: implementation
todos.description: Fix codex-remote no-workflow slow-path semantics with explicit no-workflow confidence, negative caching/single-flight, cancellation, and foreground cold-open protection. Do not return an invented empty task list when truth is unknown.

verification.summary: Implemented codex-remote background-task scan protection: projection-not-ready fail-closed response, 30s bounded real scan, per-session/per-syncRev single-flight, successful negative-result cache, error retry semantics, and workflow-present projection fast path. Summary-only no-workflow is never inferred as authoritative emptiness.

todos.title: Phase 2 pairing restore race: implementation
todos.description: Make projection requests during token-refresh/stream-bind restoration return bounded hydrating behavior instead of an immediate unpaired hard failure; preserve genuine not-configured failure.

verification.summary: Implemented core.ErrRestoreInProgress and RestoreWaiter. Codex-remote waits a bounded 5s for persisted stream restoration; missing/terminal pairing remains not-configured. Projection relay/source paths map transient restore to projection.hydrating without marking source inspection failed.

todos.title: Phase 3 catalog scan cost: implementation
todos.description: Reduce unchanged Grok/catalog scan cost: avoid repeated visible-filter/stat/log work when raw truth is unchanged, deduplicate os.Stat by directory within one call, and preserve 60s deletion safety.

verification.summary: Implemented per-call directory-stat dedupe, unchanged catalog-filter drop-signature rate limiting, and a 50s raw-membership cache for Grok discovery fast polls. User-facing Grok list build still filters on every real build; TTL is below the 60s safety scan so deleted workspaces reappear as filtered.
